title: 去四川看奶奶
summary: A trip to Sichuan to visit grandma, from the early morning departure to the warm hello at the end of the journey.

sentences.text: 今天我和妈妈去四川看奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǒ hé māma qù Sìchuān kàn nǎinai.
sentences.english: Today my mom and I go to Sichuan to visit grandma.

sentences.text: 我很高兴，因为我很爱奶奶，也很想她。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng, yīnwèi wǒ hěn ài nǎinai.
sentences.english: I am very happy because I love grandma very much.

sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒmen qǐ de hěn zǎo.
sentences.english: We get up very early in the morning.

sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Wǒmen zǎodiǎn zǒu ba."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Let's leave a little early.'

sentences.pinyin: Bùrán rén hěn duō.
sentences.english: Otherwise, there will be a lot of people.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Hǎo, wǒmen zuò chē qù ma?"
sentences.english: I say, 'Okay, are we taking a bus?'

sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Duì, wǒmen zuò chē qù."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Yes, we are going by bus.'

sentences.text: 我拿了一个小包，里面有水和一点吃的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná le yí ge xiǎo bāo, lǐmiàn yǒu shuǐ hé yì diǎn chī de.
sentences.english: I took a small bag with water and a little food inside.

sentences.text: 我在想奶奶现在在做什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài xiǎng nǎinai xiànzài zài zuò shénme.
sentences.english: I am thinking about what grandma is doing now.

sentences.text: 妈妈看着我说：“你很想她吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Māma kànzhe wǒ shuō: "Nǐ hěn xiǎng tā ma?"
sentences.english: Mom looks at me and says, 'Do you miss her a lot?'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Shì de, wǒ hěn xiǎng tā."
sentences.english: I say, 'Yes, I miss her very much.'

title: 在车上
summary: A long bus ride where the mountains, water, and people outside the window become part of the trip.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài chē shàng zuò le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: We sat on the bus for a long time.

sentences.pinyin: Chē shàng yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: There were many people on the bus.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Some people were talking.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài kàn shǒujī.
sentences.english: Some people were looking at their phones.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài shuìjiào.
sentences.english: Some people were sleeping.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn chuāngwài de shān hé shuǐ.
sentences.english: I look at the mountains and water outside the window.

sentences.pinyin: Shān hěn dà, shuǐ yě hěn cháng.
sentences.english: The mountains are big, and the water is long too.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Māma, zhèlǐ hěn měi."
sentences.english: I say, 'Mom, this place is beautiful.'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“是的，四川有很多山和水。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Shì de, Sìchuān yǒu hěn duō shān hé shuǐ."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Yes, Sichuan has many mountains and rivers.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào lù biān yǒu xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: I see small houses by the road.

sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén zài zǒu.
sentences.english: There are also people walking.

sentences.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎoháizi zài pǎo.
sentences.english: A little child is running.

sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: He looks very happy.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: "Wǒmen hái yào duō jiǔ?"
sentences.english: I ask, 'How much longer do we need?'

sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Zài děng yí huìr."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Wait a little longer.'

title: 到奶奶家
summary: Arriving at grandma's house, with a warm welcome, tea on the table, and a very happy reunion.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dào le nǎinai jiā.
sentences.english: We arrived at grandma's house.

sentences.text: 奶奶在门口等我们，她看到我们很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zài ménkǒu děng wǒmen, tā kàn dào wǒmen hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: Grandma is waiting at the door, and she is very happy to see us.

sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Nǐmen lái le!"
sentences.english: She says, 'You’re here!'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Nǎinai hǎo!"
sentences.english: I say, 'Hello, grandma!'

sentences.text: 奶奶走过来抱我，说：“你长大了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zǒu guòlai bào wǒ, shuō: "Nǐ zhǎng dà le."
sentences.english: Grandma comes over and hugs me, saying, 'You've grown up.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng nǐ."
sentences.english: I say, 'I miss you too.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ zǒu jìn jiā li.
sentences.english: We walk into the house together.

sentences.text: 家不大，但是很干净，也很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Jiā bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng, yě hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: The house is not big, but it is clean and comfortable.

sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu chá hé shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: There is tea and fruit on the table.

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“你们累吗？先坐一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Nǐmen lèi ma? Xiān zuò yíxià ba."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Are you tired? Sit down first.'

title: 奶奶做饭
summary: Grandma cooks lunch while everyone watches, helps, and waits for the food to be ready.

sentences.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ nǎinai zuò fàn.
sentences.english: At noon, grandma cooks.

sentences.text: 她在厨房里很忙，我和妈妈在旁边看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chúfáng li hěn máng, wǒ hé māma zài pángbiān kàn.
sentences.english: She is busy in the kitchen, and Mom and I watch from the side.

sentences.text: 我说：“奶奶，我可以帮你吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Nǎinai, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ ma?"
sentences.english: I say, 'Grandma, can I help you?'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“可以，你帮我拿菜。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Kěyǐ, nǐ bāng wǒ ná cài."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Yes, help me carry the vegetables.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná le cài hé shuǐ.
sentences.english: I brought the vegetables and water.

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò le mǐfàn, cài hé tāng.
sentences.english: Grandma made rice, vegetables, and soup.

sentences.text: 厨房里很香，我觉得很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng li hěn xiāng, wǒ juéde hěn è.
sentences.english: The kitchen smells great, and I feel very hungry.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Nǎinai, hǎo xiāng a!"
sentences.english: I say, 'Grandma, it smells so good!'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“一会儿我们一起吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Yíhuìr wǒmen yìqǐ chī."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'We’ll eat together in a moment.'

title: 吃饭聊天
summary: A family meal turns into a cheerful conversation about studying, books, and everyday life.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn.
sentences.english: We eat together.

sentences.text: 米饭很好吃，菜也很好吃，汤很好喝。
sentences.pinyin: Mǐfàn hěn hǎochī, cài yě hěn hǎochī, tāng hěn hǎohē.
sentences.english: The rice is delicious, the vegetables are delicious, and the soup is tasty too.

sentences.text: 奶奶问我：“你现在学习吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai wèn wǒ: "Nǐ xiànzài xuéxí ma?"
sentences.english: Grandma asks me, 'Are you studying now?'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén."
sentences.english: I say, 'I study Chinese.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě xuéxí yì diǎn Yīngwén.
sentences.english: I also study a little English.

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“很好，学习很重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Hěn hǎo, xuéxí hěn zhòngyào."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Very good, learning is important.'

sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Tā měitiān dōu xuéxí."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'He studies every day.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ hěn xǐhuan xuéxí."
sentences.english: I say, 'I really like studying.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan kàn shū.
sentences.english: I also like reading books.

sentences.text: 我们一边吃饭，一边聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān chī fàn, yìbiān liáotiān.
sentences.english: We chat while eating.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: I feel very happy.

title: 去市场
summary: An afternoon market visit with fruit, tea, heat, and a lot of people.

sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ hé nǎinai qù shìchǎng.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, Grandma and I go to the market.

sentences.text: 市场里有很多人，也有很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng li yǒu hěn duō rén, yě yǒu hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.english: There are many people and many things in the market.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn dào hěn duō shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: We see many fruits.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu píngguǒ.
sentences.english: There are apples.

sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu bié de shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: There are also other fruits.

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Zhèxiē dōu hěn hǎochī."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'These are all very tasty.'

sentences.text: 我们买了一些水果，也买了茶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le yìxiē shuǐguǒ, yě mǎi le chá.
sentences.english: We bought some fruit and also some tea.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǎinai ná dōngxi.
sentences.english: I help Grandma carry the things.

sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yǒu yìdiǎn rè, rén hěn duō.
sentences.english: The weather is a little hot, and there are a lot of people.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Zhèlǐ zhēn de hěn rè."
sentences.english: I say, 'It is really hot here.'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“是的，但是东西很好。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Shì de, dànshì dōngxi hěn hǎo."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Yes, but the things are good.'

title: 在奶奶家的生活
summary: A simple daily routine of water, breakfast, reading, rest, and evening TV at grandma's house.

sentences.text: 在奶奶家，我的生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nǎinai jiā, wǒ de shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: At grandma's house, my life is very simple.

sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hē shuǐ, chī zǎofàn.
sentences.english: In the morning, I drink water and eat breakfast.

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò fàn, māma bāng tā.
sentences.english: Grandma cooks, and Mom helps her.

sentences.text: 下午我看书，写字，也学习中文。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ kàn shū, xiě zì, yě xuéxí Zhōngwén.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, I read, write, and study Chinese.

sentences.text: 有时候我和妈妈说话，有时候我休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou wǒ hé māma shuōhuà, yǒu shíhou wǒ xiūxi.
sentences.english: Sometimes Mom and I talk, and sometimes I rest.

sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ kàn diànshì.
sentences.english: At night, we watch TV together.

sentences.text: 奶奶喜欢说话，她会说很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xǐhuan shuōhuà, tā huì shuō hěn duō shìqing.
sentences.english: Grandma likes to talk, and she can tell many things.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīng, yě huì wèn wèntí.
sentences.english: I like to listen, and I also ask questions.

sentences.text: 我觉得这样的生活很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèyàng de shēnghuó hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: I think this kind of life is very good.

title: 四川的城市
summary: A walk through a big city full of shops, people, and interesting things to see.

sentences.text: 有一天，我和妈妈出去走走。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, wǒ hé māma chūqù zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: One day, Mom and I go out for a walk.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì hěn dà.
sentences.english: This city is very big.

sentences.pinyin: Rén hěn duō, diàn yě hěn duō.
sentences.english: There are many people and many shops.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn dào hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: We see many people.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Some people are working.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài chī fàn.
sentences.english: Some people are eating.

sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu hěn duō xiǎo diàn.
sentences.english: There are also many small shops.

sentences.pinyin: Mài chī de, hē de, hái yǒu yīfu.
sentences.english: They sell food, drinks, and clothes.

sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn rè.
sentences.english: The weather is very hot.

sentences.pinyin: Dànshì wǒ háishi hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: But I am still very happy.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Zhèlǐ hěn yǒuyìsi."
sentences.english: I say, 'This place is interesting.'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“是的，每个地方都不一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Shì de, měi ge dìfang dōu bù yíyàng."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Yes, every place is different.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: We walked for a long time.

sentences.pinyin: Kàn le hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.english: We saw many things.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn lèi.
sentences.english: I am a little tired.

sentences.pinyin: Dànshì hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: But I am very happy.

title: 回家
summary: The goodbye before heading home, full of thanks, hugs, and memories that stay with you.

sentences.text: 时间过得很快，我们要回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de hěn kuài, wǒmen yào huí jiā le.
sentences.english: Time passed very quickly, and we have to go home.

sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen jiù yào zǒu le.
sentences.english: Tomorrow we will leave.

sentences.text: 我有一点不开心，因为我不想走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn bù kāixīn, yīnwèi wǒ bù xiǎng zǒu.
sentences.english: I feel a little unhappy because I don't want to leave.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái xiǎng hé nǎinai zài yìqǐ.
sentences.english: I still want to be with grandma.

sentences.text: 我对奶奶说：“谢谢你，我很开心。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì nǎinai shuō: "Xièxie nǐ, wǒ hěn kāixīn."
sentences.english: I say to grandma, 'Thank you, I am very happy.'

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Nǐ yǐhòu zài lái."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Come again later.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ huì zài lái de."
sentences.english: I say, 'I will come again.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bào le yíxià.
sentences.english: We hugged.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ huì hěn xiǎng nǐ."
sentences.english: I say, 'I will miss you very much.'

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Wǒ yě huì xiǎng nǐ."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'I will miss you too.'

sentences.text: 在回家的路上，我一直在想。
sentences.pinyin: Zài huí jiā de lù shang, wǒ yìzhí zài xiǎng.
sentences.english: On the way home, I keep thinking.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: About these past few days.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: I feel very happy.

sentences.pinyin: Yě hěn nánwàng.
sentences.english: And it is unforgettable.
